userStories.title: Dashboard diagram generation API endpoint
userStories.description: Add a simple HTTP endpoint to the dashboard server that runs generate_diagram.py and returns the SVG
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/diagram accepts {text, type, style} JSON body
Returns SVG content or file path
userStories.notes: Dashboard runs on Python HTTP server at localhost:8888

userStories.title: Wire diagram-viewer Generate button to API
userStories.description: Connect the Generate button in diagram-viewer.html to the /api/diagram endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Displays generated diagram in the grid
userStories.notes: Currently shows CLI command instead of calling API

userStories.title: Auto-scan diagrams folder for viewer
userStories.description: Diagram viewer should auto-discover all SVGs in diagrams/ folder
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/diagrams returns list of all SVG files
Shows file size and creation date
userStories.notes: Currently has hardcoded list of known files
